definition: Latest executed move before current own turn within current32turn window; repeat/change classified from current label only for diagnosis. Saved final fitting predictions, no new forecasts/optimization. No evaluation rows.
formula: last=argmax(command_heading[...,1]); available=max(command_heading[...,1])>0; repeat=available and label==last; change=available and label!=last; no_prior_move=not available
